remarks: Opportunity knocks in Buffalo’s Riverside neighborhood! Situated on a prime corner lot at 894 Tonawanda Street, this renovated mixed-use building offers both commercial potential and residential comfort in one of Buffalo’s most up-and-coming areas. The property features previously operated restaurant on the first floor, ideal for a seamless transition or a fresh start in a vibrant, walkable area. Above the restaurant, a spacious 3-bedroom and 1.5 bath apartment provides the perfect space for owner-occupancy or additional rental income. Recently renovated inside and out, the building boasts significant upgrades including a new installed hood, flooring, drywalls, electric, plumbing, new boiler, furnace, and hot water tank in 2024, along with a full renovation just two years ago—offering turnkey convenience for the next owner. The location is unbeatable. Nestled in the heart of Buffalo’s Riverside district, this property is just a few blocks from the Niagara River, parks, trails, and the scenic Riverwalk. Tonawanda Street itself is a bustling corridor with great foot traffic, close to local shops, schools, and public transportation. You're just minutes from the Scajaquada Expressway, Downtown Buffalo, and North Tonawanda, making it easy to draw customers from across the region. Whether you're looking to grow your business, live above your shop, or invest in a high-potential neighborhood, this property checks all the boxes. Don't miss out and step into your next chapter on Tonawanda Street! Also listed as Commercial MLS # B1698565
